title: Research Suggestions
subtitle: Top Picks For Oct 13, 2026
intro: Ideas only. Owners build after Max approves.

cards.label: QR Stickers For The Home Guide
cards.line: Home Guide is the most-used app (20 sign-ins in the last pull). A sticker puts the answer on the equipment.
cards.next: Give each section its own link, then print 5 to 8 stickers.

cards.label: Talk Instead Of Type At Each Stop
cards.line: Stop 1 started 8 times, 1 walk finished. Typing may be part of the drop-off (unconfirmed).
cards.next: Pick a pattern. A uses built-in browser dictation, no AI cost.

optionA.label: Mic On Each Note
optionA.desc: Quick Caption style: tap, speak, edit.

optionB.label: One Spoken Walkthrough
optionB.desc: Walkthrough Note style: voice plus photos, one document.

cards.label: Missed Words Come Back Sooner
cards.line: 94 active words all get the same turn. FSRS moves each word's next review by how you answered.
cards.next: Run ts-fsrs in the page, progress saved in the browser.

cards.label: Address Suggestions On The First Step
cards.line: Baymard found live address suggestions performed best, and 55% of sites lack them.
cards.next: Price a paid lookup service (for example Google Places) first.

cards.label: Install Prompt Right After Sign-In
cards.line: 13 Home Guide sign-ins, but only 1 open of the add-to-home-screen option.
cards.next: Dismissible card in preview.html first; live after Max approves.
